note: Four independent auditors (engine, data pipeline, tariff facts, agreement parameters) reviewed the Analysis C code and inputs; every finding of medium or high severity was then handed to a separate verifier instructed to refute it. Seven findings were refuted on verification only because the fix had already been applied to the file by the time the verifier read it; they are listed here as confirmed-and-fixed. Low-severity items are listed where they led to a change.

confirmed.title: Pooled TRQ slice overwritten for CN8 lines imported from several partners (fresh beef from AR and BR shared one quota slice and the last partner's share overwrote the others)
confirmed.resolution: Each import line now carries a unique identifier (CN8|partner) and the pooled notional Greek quota slice is attached by that identifier.

confirmed.title: Capacity weights and the HS 04 chapter cap followed the published v7.5 driver rather than the corrected v8.1 driver
confirmed.resolution: B and C runs use the v8.1 convention: capacity weights extended to the added agri-food chapters (02, 07, 10 at 1.0; 16, 17 at 0.8; 21 at 0.5; 03 at 0) and no chapter-level HS 04 cap, since the line-level quota logic supersedes it. A keeps its own v7.5 settings.

confirmed.title: Frozen Illex squid (CN 0307 43 92, about 5 million dollars a year) has no row in the agreement schedule, which is written in CN 2013 (where it was 0307 99 11), so the line was treated as never liberalised; the agreement and TARIC make it duty-free at entry into force
confirmed.resolution: For any traded CN8 code with no exact schedule row, the staging category is now inferred from the Mercosur preference TARIC applies today (ratio of preferential to erga-omnes duty at the Greek unit value), with HS6 and HS4 schedule rows as further fallbacks. Squid resolves to category 0.

confirmed.title: Greek extra-virgin olive-oil exports are coded 1509 20 00 (HS 2022) and have no row in the Mercosur schedule, which is written in NCM 2012; the line fell back to a generic 10-year path and a WITS base instead of category 15 at 10% (31.5% for Argentina)
confirmed.resolution: The Mercosur side now falls back to the heading-level NCM rows (all 1509 rows: category 15, base 10% and 31.5%) when the six-digit code is absent.

confirmed.title: The certified/uncertified tobacco rule assumed one certificate sub-line ending in 10; CN 2401 20 35 has two certified sub-lines (Burley and Maryland types)
confirmed.resolution: Certified leaf is now identified as the sub-line with the lowest ad valorem equivalent at the Greek unit value (the 18.4% MIN 22 MAX 24 EUR/100 kg treatment), uncertified as the highest, independent of the sub-line number.

confirmed.title: CN 2710 19 51 (fuel oil for a specific process) carries a conventional 3.5% that is never collected: classification there requires the end-use procedure at the autonomous rate Free
confirmed.resolution: A documented legal override sets the duty on 2710 19 51 to 0% with the CN footnote as justification.

confirmed.title: The duty parser could not value duties expressed per tonne ('23.00 EUR / tonne' on feed preparations CN 2309 90 31), so the line fell back to a WITS six-digit average of 40%; the exact equivalent at the Greek unit value is 2.4%, a difference of about 1.6 million dollars in Year 10 imports
confirmed.resolution: Units per tonne, per 1000 kg and per kg are now converted from the COMEXT value per 100 kg; unparseable duty strings return no value instead of zero so the fallback chain is used explicitly.

confirmed.title: The ethanol density (1.266 hl per 100 kg) was applied to every per-hectolitre duty, overstating the equivalents on wine and on concentrated grape juice (42.5% instead of about 34.6%)
confirmed.resolution: A per-heading density table is used: ethanol 0.79 kg/l, wine 0.99, spirits 0.95, concentrated juices (Brix above 67) 1.3, other juices 1.05.

confirmed.title: Year-0 quota volumes were pro-rated by 245/365 while the tariff path is pro-rated by 8/12; the Commission opened the 2026 quotas at 8/12

not_changed.title: The 450,000 t duty-free chemical-industry ethanol pool is not represented, only the 200,000 t all-uses pool at one third of the MFN duty
not_changed.reason: The corrected manuscript reports that adding the chemical-use pool changes the Year 10 widening by less than 0.02 million dollars; Greek denatured-ethanol imports are 4.5 million dollars a year and the all-uses slice already covers them in the central case.

not_changed.title: Pears (CN 0808 30 90) carry a seasonal duty of 0 to 10.4%; a single reading date understates or overstates the year
not_changed.reason: The line is 1.1 million dollars a year and Argentine pears arrive mainly in the 0 to 5% windows; the reading at 1 July (duty-free fortnight) is kept and the effect on the headline is below 0.1 million dollars.

not_changed.title: Where several schedule rows share a six-digit code, compound or specific base rates receive a flat weight of 0.05 in the base-weighted staging average
not_changed.reason: With the exact eight-digit match and the TARIC-implied category in place, the six-digit average is reached only for small residual lines.
